stories.headline: US AI task force launches risk study
stories.summary: A new federal AI task force established a 120-day structure, risk study and committees for breaches, infrastructure and enforcement. Details remain preliminary; violations would be referred to the FTC or Justice Department.

stories.headline: Anthropic projects large AI growth boost
stories.summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark said an internal model puts US GDP at $44 trillion by 2030 and urged international rules. He called the figure outlandish; it is a company projection, not an independent forecast.

stories.headline: Trump–Zelenskiy rift threatens Ukraine support
stories.summary: US–Ukraine tensions deepened over attacks on Russian refineries, intelligence support and a US diesel deal with Moscow. Trump says intelligence sharing continues, while Zelenskiy says Ukrainian commanders were warned it could be reduced.

stories.headline: US measles count reaches 4,410
stories.summary: The CDC reported 4,410 US measles cases through October 15, up 330 in one week. The outbreak is the largest since US elimination in 2000; vaccination remains the principal protection.

stories.headline: IMF delegates walk out on Russian official
stories.summary: Nearly half of delegates walked out during Russia's finance minister's remarks, highlighting divisions over Ukraine. The IMF steering committee nevertheless agreed the global economy is resilient but faces war, debt, energy and AI risks.
